findings.title: Seal semantic observation producers
findings.analysis: ConformsTo and TargetKind are ordinary fresh predicates in the proposal. Generic RuleValid and normalization permit ordinary heads and ordinary seeds. A valid derivation can therefore establish logical consequence without establishing graph-source meaning. Current captured workflow rejects these new heads; this is not a reproduced v1 false acceptance. Seal observation producers separately from authority root roles.

findings.title: Move baseline/profile design before integration
findings.analysis: Classifier baseline(), integration capture() and bundle execution_profile() bind the captured empty-rule graph and ReviewSignal vocabulary. S06 asks for nonempty old baselines before S09 introduces successor baseline design. Specify registered baseline/profile/catalog contracts earlier; S09 should qualify application.

findings.title: Specify target-kind encoding and finite domain
findings.analysis: ValueSort has no kind sort. TargetKind(reference,contract) needs a checked text literal in the domain and an independent node-kind projection. New targets/scopes/kind values cannot silently satisfy domain_same during rule-only expansion.

findings.title: Define contextual assessment keys and contradictions
findings.analysis: Unique tokens do not define how different assessments for the same condition/context disagree. Stress conformance rows permit accepted=true and accepted=false. Require consistent selected evaluations for an exact key, or report an explicit conflict/invalid diagnostic blocking positive projection. Missing stays unknown; issuer truth remains assumed.

findings.title: Separate potential norms, activation and fulfillment
findings.analysis: Matches compares condition labels and interpreted flags. Origin and closure propagate norms without condition evaluation; ConflictPair compares a same-condition require/forbid pair. These are potential norms/conflicts. ActiveNorm requires an exact holds assessment; fulfillment requires separate action evidence.

findings.title: Protect resource budgets before broadening runtime
findings.analysis: choices constructs d^k candidates before sort filtering. Stress workUnits computes candidateFacts and closure before checking budget. Finite termination and post-computation logical budgets do not establish time or RSS ceilings. Add early conservative bounds and measured stage ceilings before rich runtime integration.

findings.title: Separate candidate validity from observed membership
findings.analysis: InstanceValid, ConformsAt and delegation Effective intentionally evaluate a supplied candidate without Recorded membership. Origin requires membership. Keep candidate meanings and define separate observed predicates requiring exact membership/support at projection leaves. Do not strengthen accepted definitions globally.

findings.title: Give source interpretations and data transitions their own task
findings.analysis: Registry qualifiers are closed nonempty strings. F0 uses three kinds and a single conformance evidence token; registry uses plural evidence references and broader pair sets. Stress adds actions, conditions and assessments absent from legacy qualifiers. Rich baseline capture and source/fact/domain changes need distinct change classes and obligations.

findings.title: Bind reference meaning across snapshots
findings.analysis: Graph invariants give local id/version uniqueness, not global immutability of content or kind. Existing byte bindings detect selected drift but do not authenticate issuers. Qualify immutable ref-to-content/kind bindings across snapshots or require a changed revision; reject same-reference substitution.

findings.title: Version generic theory and executable profile separately
findings.analysis: Frontend requires exact mandatory CORE and unique rule id/version; TheoryValid checks a more general logical theory. The verifier has a fixed import list and trusted catalogs. Specify stronger executable profile and checked mapping, update trusted catalogs from independent statement types, and retain decoder/generator trust limits.

findings.title: Resolve source wording before stronger theorem claims
findings.analysis: Each captured source was inspected. fulfills-request operational text says fulfillment while its question says intended fulfillment. successor-of specifies supersedes but leaves actual lifecycle/currentness policy outside generic strings. Role/posture declarations often mix intent, attempt and result. Fix independently reviewed meanings before promoting any stronger claim.

findings.title: Expose exact claim and model class in outcomes
findings.analysis: Derivation proves one query; checked closure proves profile-relative nonderivability; a countermodel refutes one implication. Stress certificates check listed Origins and shape, not GraphValid, a requested query or completeness. Closed, ModelValid and SemanticModel differ. Compose exact required obligations and name the result claim accurately.
